llms.txt (https://llmstxt.org): a plain-Markdown map of the site for AI assistants and answer engines.
Built from page front matter, so it follows the published copy version and never lists a page that isn't
live (ad landing pages, noindex pages, pages from the other copy version). Facts come from _config.yml
`company` and _data/locations.yml, the same sources as the footer and structured data.
{%- endcomment -%}

# {{ site.title }}

> {{ summary | strip | normalize_whitespace }}

{{ site.title }} is a litigation support firm founded in {{ site.company.founded }} and headquartered at the Philadelphia Navy Yard. Attorneys, corporations, and public agencies hire us to find digital evidence, manage it through discovery, and present it in court: certified digital forensic examiners, cell site analysis, and expert witness testimony; e-Discovery processing, hosting, and review on our own platform, Junto; and certified trial technicians. We work on criminal and civil matters in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, New York, and Delaware, and for clients across the United States.

Key facts:

- Services: digital forensics (computers, phones, cloud accounts), mobile device forensics, locked and encrypted iPhone and Android extraction (passcode recovery, Before First Unlock, and full file system extractions with Cellebrite and Magnet Forensics), JTAG and chip-off for damaged devices, cell site analysis and call detail records, expert witness testimony and rebuttal, e-Discovery (collection, processing, early case assessment, managed review, production), criminal discovery management for multi-defendant cases, document management, paper discovery, printing and scanning, and trial presentation and exhibit management.
- Clients: criminal defense attorneys, public defenders, and court-appointed (CJA) counsel; civil litigators; corporate legal and HR teams; and schools and public agencies.
- Recognition: The Legal Intelligencer "Best Of" 2025: voted the #1 Digital Forensic Company for the third consecutive year, and ranked #3 in End-to-End eDiscovery, Trial Technology, Hot Seat Trial Technicians, and Demonstrative Evidence Provider, with Hall of Fame recognition ({{ '/cornerstone-discovery-winner-of-legal-intelligencer-2025-best-of-survey/' | absolute_url }}).
- Phone: {{ site.company.phone }}. Email: {{ site.company.email }}. Contact form: {{ '/contact/' | absolute_url }}
- Offices:{% for loc in site.data.locations %}
  - {{ loc.name }}: {{ loc.street }}{% if loc.suite %}, {{ loc.suite }}{% endif %}, {{ loc.city }}, {{ loc.region }} {{ loc.postal_code }} ({{ loc.area }}){% endfor %}
- Profiles: {{ site.social.linkedin }}, {{ site.social.facebook }}, {{ site.social.x }}
